title: Redistribution-based Cost Inference Improves Sparse Safe Offline RL
abstract: arXiv:2608.12306v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safe offline RL typically assumes access to dense per-step cost annotations, but in practice supervisors provide only trajectory-level stop-feedback: a binary signal at the first unsafe transition, with no per-step attribution. We frame this as a temporal credit assignment problem and propose the Redistribution-based Cost Inference (RCI) framework, which converts sparse stop-feedback into dense per-step costs via return decomposition, then trains a constrained offline policy on the augmented dataset. We show that return-equivalent redistribution preserves the feasible policy set and the optimal Lagrangian in a CMDP, establishing that the transformation is lossless in theory while yielding better-conditioned cost critic learning in practice. Experiments on highway driving and robotic manipulation demonstrate substantially lower violation rates than sparse and classifier-based baselines, with robustness to heterogeneous dataset compositi

translated_title: 基于再分配的成本推断改进稀疏安全离线强化学习
translated_abstract: 安全离线强化学习通常假设可以访问密集的每步成本注释，但在实际应用中，监督者仅提供轨迹级别的停止反馈：即在第一次不安全转换时的二元信号，而没有每步的归因。我们将此问题视为时间信用分配问题，并提出基于再分配的成本推断（RCI）框架，该框架通过回报分解将稀疏的停止反馈转换为密集的每步成本，然后在增强数据集上训练约束离线策略。我们证明，回报等价的再分配保留了CMDP中的可行策略集和最优拉格朗日乘子，从而在理论上确立了该转换的无损性，同时在实践中改善了成本评论家学习的条件。在高速公路驾驶和机器人操作上的实验表明，与稀疏和基于分类器的基线相比，违规率显著降低，并且对异质数据集组成具有鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出RCI框架，将稀疏的轨迹级停止反馈转换为密集的每步成本，在理论上无损且实践中改善成本学习，显著降低安全离线强化学习中的违规率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the RCI framework that converts sparse trajectory-level stop-feedback into dense per-step costs, theoretically lossless and practically improving cost learning, substantially reducing violation rates in safe offline RL.
